لُجٌّ The side of a valley. (K.) ―
-b2- The side, or shore, of a sea. (L.) [See also لُجَّةٌ.] ―
-b3- A rugged part of a mountain. (K.) ―
-b4- (tropical:) A sword: (S, K:) app. from لُجٌّ with reference to the sea, because of its terribleness: (As:) thought by ISd to occur only in one instance, in a trad.: said to be of the dial. of Teiyi; or of Hudheyl, and of some of the people of El-Yemen. (TA.) ―
-b5- Also لُجَّةٌ, (tropical:) A mirror. (K.) ―
-b6- And (tropical:) Silver. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
